articles.title: A Stormy Thanksgiving Across America
articles.summary: Thanksgiving storms brought floods, strong winds, and power cuts across America, delaying flights and postponing the Macy's parade.

articles.title: Native Flavors Shine in Albuquerque
articles.summary: At Indian Pueblo Kitchen in Albuquerque, Native American dishes take center stage, from blue corn enchiladas to Rita Toledo's famous biscochitos.

articles.title: He Won $1 Million, Then He Was Arrested Days Later
articles.summary: A Massachusetts man won $1 million on a scratch ticket, then ICE said it arrested him days later; he stays in custody while his family asks for respect and empathy.
